newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trade in China Everbright Int'l suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trade in China Everbright Int'l suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of property, trading and securities concern China Everbright International Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Tuesday.
The company's shares ended HK$0.205 higher at HK$2.125 on Monday on volume of 129.26 million shares.

Trading in shares of the other two listed companies controlled by China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd -- China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd and China Everbright Technology Ltd -- was suspended at their own request on Monday.
Earlier this month, CITIC Pacific Ltd said it had agreed to sell a 7.74 percent stake in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd to China Everbright Holdings for about HK$11.4 billion in cash.
